result.summary: The page is mostly polished, but there are a few visual/content issues: a truncated restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, low-contrast placeholder text in the search bar, and the last visible card in 'Popular right now' is cut off at the bottom edge.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row shows the name 'Trattoria Piccol' with the final part of the name cut off, making it unclear whether the name is incomplete or just truncated.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation (e.g., ellipsis) or allow the name to wrap to a second line, and ensure the card width can accommodate the full name.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' uses a light gray color on a light gray background, resulting in low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color to meet minimum contrast guidelines (e.g., WCAG 4.5:1 for normal text).

issues.description: The second card in the 'Popular right now' section is partially cut off at the bottom of the screen, which may hide content or make it unclear that the list continues.
issues.suggestion: Add adequate bottom padding/safe-area inset above the fixed bottom navigation so the last card is fully visible when scrolled to the end.
